description: Inputs decode to records, maps, tuples, options, and results through the type-directed decoder.
program: (script {:inputs {:row "Record {name: String, hits: Option<Int>}" :totals "Map<String, Int>" :pair "Tuple<Int, String>" :verdict "Result<Int, String>" :ratio "Float" :flag "Bool" :blob "Bytes"}} {:name (get row :name) :hits (get row :hits) :a (get totals "a" 0) :n (first pair) :s (nth pair 1) :v (match verdict (ok n) n (err e) 0) :r (* ratio 2.0) :f (not flag) :len (count blob)})
